# Where each entry of an uploaded archive is extracted.
module ArchivePaths
  def self.destination(dest, entry_name)
    File.join(dest, entry_name)
  end
end

require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'archive_paths'

class ArchivePathsTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_joins_entry
    assert_equal 'out/a.txt', ArchivePaths.destination('out', 'a.txt')
  end
end
